newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba, Viag to seek more of Bewag - report.
newsitem.headline: Veba, Viag to seek more of Bewag - report.

text.p: German utilities Veba AG and Viag AG are to bid for higher stakes in Berliner Kraft und Licht AG (Bewag), in which they each have minority holdings, a German newspaper reported on Wednesday.

Veba manager and Bewag supervisory board member Alfred Dworak told the Boersen-Zeitung newspaper that the two companies were interested in taking on a package of more than 25.8 percent in Bewag from the state of Berlin.
"We will put forward a joint offer on Friday," the newspaper quoted Dworak as saying.
Veba would take on 14.8 percent of the shares and Viag 11 percent, Dworak told the newspaper.
The companies each already own 10 percent of Bewag's capital via subsidiaries and control 14 percent of its voting rights.

Separately, the Financial Times reported that British electricity generator Powergen Plc was considering making an offer for Bewag, which is still majority-owned by Berlin but due for privatisation next year.
